Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using V5-tagged H3.3 to identify interaction partners. Label-free quantification (LFQ) is inferred from the use of MaxQuant without mention of isobaric tags or SILAC. PRIDE metadata confirms the use of MaxQuant and the AP-MS experiment type.

scope: Anti-V5 tag magnetic beads were added to the lysates (50ul of beads to 1mg of protein), and samples incubated in a rotator for 4 hours at 4C.
washed beads were flash frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80C until further processing for mass-spectrometry as below.
After washing, beads were incubated for 30 minutes at 27C in 2M urea, 75 mM Tris pH8.5, 1mM DTT, and 0.3 ug trypsin in a total volume of 100uL.
we next performed V5 epitope-based pull-down followed by mass spectrometry in order to identify protein interaction partners of WT and G34R-mutant H3.3
